'''New Shallos''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]] during the [[Old Sith Wars]]. It was bombed from orbit by [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] [[Myrialites]] during the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]].
